name: Ollama
description: Run open-source large language models locally. Supports Llama 3, Mistral, Gemma, Phi, and many more.

env.label: Listen Address
env.description: Address and port Ollama binds to (default 127.0.0.1:11434, set 0.0.0.0 for Docker)

env.label: Models Directory
env.description: Directory path where Ollama stores downloaded models

env.label: Parallel Requests
env.description: Maximum number of parallel inference requests

env.label: Max Loaded Models
env.description: Maximum number of models loaded concurrently in memory

env.label: Keep Alive Duration
env.description: How long to keep a model loaded in memory after last request (e.g. 5m, 1h, 0 to unload immediately)

env.label: Allowed Origins
env.description: Comma-separated list of allowed CORS origins (e.g. http://localhost:3000)
